title: Determine the Net Torque
text: What should the net torque be when the chicken is just about to tip over (in $$\text{N}\cdot\text{m})$$?

title: Set Up the Torques
text: Take torques about the point where the chicken would tip. The chicken's weight $$mg$$ acts at its center of gravity, and the wind force $$F$$ acts at the height shown in the figure. Set the two torques equal and solve for $$F$$.
